title: Institution gazetteer
description: Named institutions used as coreference anchors and negative-context expansions by the Swift engine. Phase 2 emits only federal_agency rows; a later phase adds financial_institution (FDIC bank list) and employer (curated SEC EDGAR filers) so the header-anchor path covers tax and financial documents. The enum reserves federal_court, state_official, and local_clerk for later phases. Entries are sorted by name for deterministic output.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. Aggregation is not itself randomized; the field is included for uniformity with other Phase 2 artifacts.

sources.description: Provenance records for every raw source folded into this artifact. Each entry carries the SHA-256 of the committed raw file and the retrieval date as documented in SOURCES.md.

id.description: Stable identifier resolving to a row in SOURCES.md.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw source file.

retrieval_date.description: ISO date on which the raw source was fetched.

entries.description: Institution entries in ascending name order.

name.description: Canonical display name for the institution.

aliases.description: Alternative surface forms (abbreviations, scoped variants). Sorted for determinism.

category.description: Institution category. federal_agency anchors the foia doctype; financial_institution and employer anchor the financial doctype (paired Swift change: InstitutionGazetteer.anchoredDoctype). federal_court, state_official, and local_clerk are reserved for later phases.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions the institution operates in. Federal-agency entries are always ["US"].
